title: Web Browsing, Searching, and Bookmarks
description: Master browser navigation, Google search operators, and bookmark organization
objective: Students will navigate web browsers effectively, use advanced Google search operators, organize bookmarks into folders, and understand browser interface components

steps.title: Explore Browser Interface
steps.instructions:
Open **Google Chrome** and let us identify every part of the browser.

**Step A: Identify these parts on your screen:**
1. **Address Bar** — The long bar at the top where you type URLs. Click on it and type `www.google.com`, then press Enter.
2. **Tabs** — Look at the top of your browser. You should see one tab. Now press **Ctrl + T** to open a new tab. How many tabs do you have now? ___
3. **Navigation Buttons** — Find the Back arrow, Forward arrow, and Refresh button (left side of address bar)
4. **Menu Button** — Find the three dots in the top-right corner. Click it to see options.
5. **Bookmarks Bar** — Press **Ctrl + Shift + B** to show/hide the bookmarks bar below the address bar.

**Step B: Practice tab management:**
- Open 3 tabs with these websites:
  - Tab 1: https://www.google.com
  - Tab 2: https://www.irctc.co.in
  - Tab 3: https://www.digilocker.gov.in
- Use **Ctrl + Tab** to switch between tabs
- Close Tab 3 using **Ctrl + W**
- Reopen it using **Ctrl + Shift + T** (reopens last closed tab)

**Step C: Check security indicators:**
- On the IRCTC tab, look at the address bar
- Do you see a padlock icon? ___
- Does the URL start with `https://`? ___
- The padlock means the connection is encrypted (secure)

**Record the browser name and version:**
- Click the three dots > Help > About Google Chrome
- Browser: _______________ Version: _______________

steps.title: Master Google Search Operators
steps.instructions:
Google has special search operators that make searching more precise. Let us practice each one.

**Open Google (google.com) and try each search:**

**1. Exact Phrase (double quotes):**
```
"Domain Name System"
```
Number of results: _______________
Now search WITHOUT quotes: `Domain Name System`
Number of results: _______________
Which gave more results? Why?

**2. Exclude Words (minus sign):**
```
apple -fruit
```
Do results show Apple company or the fruit? _______________

**3. Search Within a Website (site:):**
```
site:irctc.co.in cancellation policy
```
This searches ONLY within irctc.co.in. First result title: _______________

**4. Find Specific File Types (filetype:):**
```
CCC exam syllabus 2026 filetype:pdf
```
Did you find PDF files? _______________

**5. Definition (define:):**
```
define:protocol
```
What definition did Google show? _______________

**6. Calculator:**
Type in Google: `1500 * 18 / 100`
Answer: _______________

**7. Unit Converter:**
Type: `100 USD to INR`
Result: _______________

**8. Weather:**
Type: `weather Bhopal`
Today's temperature: _______________

**Fill in this operator reference table:**
| Operator | Purpose | Your Example |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| "..." | Exact phrase match | |
| -word | Exclude word | |
| site: | Search one website | |
| filetype: | Find file type | |
| define: | Get definition | |
| OR | Either of two terms | |

steps.title: Organize Bookmarks
steps.instructions:
Bookmarks help you save and quickly access your favorite websites. Let us create an organized bookmark system.

**Step A: Create bookmark folders**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + O** to open Bookmark Manager
2. Click the three dots at the top-right > **Add new folder**
3. Create these folders:
   - **CCC Study Material**
   - **Government Services**
   - **Daily Use**

**Step B: Add bookmarks to folders**

Visit each website and press **Ctrl + D** to bookmark it. Choose the correct folder.

*CCC Study Material:*
- https://www.nielit.gov.in
- https://www.geeksforgeeks.org
- https://edu.gcfglobal.org

*Government Services:*
- https://www.digilocker.gov.in
- https://web.umang.gov.in
- https://www.irctc.co.in

*Daily Use:*
- https://mail.google.com
- https://www.google.com
- One website of your choice: _______________

**Step C: Customize the Bookmarks Bar**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + B** to show the bookmarks bar
2. Drag your 3 most-used bookmarks from Bookmark Manager to the bookmarks bar
3. To save space: right-click a bookmark on the bar > Edit > remove the name (keep only the icon)

**Step D: Take a screenshot** of your Bookmark Manager showing all 3 folders with their contents.

**Questions:**
- What is the shortcut to add a bookmark? _______________
- What is the shortcut to open Bookmark Manager? _______________
- What is the shortcut to show/hide bookmarks bar? _______________

steps.title: Browser Configuration
steps.instructions:
Let us explore and configure important browser settings.

**Step A: Check your homepage**
1. Click the three dots > **Settings**
2. In the left sidebar, click **On startup**
3. What is your current startup setting? _______________
4. Change it to: **Open a specific page** > Add `https://www.google.com`
5. Close Chrome completely and reopen it
6. Did Google open as your homepage? _______________

**Step B: Check privacy settings**
1. Go to Settings > **Privacy and Security**
2. Click **Security**
   - Is Safe Browsing enabled? _______________
   - What protection level is set? (Enhanced/Standard) _______________
3. Go back > Click **Cookies and other site data**
   - Are third-party cookies blocked? _______________

**Step C: Try Incognito Mode**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + N** to open Incognito window
2. Notice the dark theme and Incognito icon
3. Visit 3 websites:
   - www.google.com
   - www.irctc.co.in
   - www.flipkart.com
4. Close the Incognito window completely
5. In your normal Chrome window, press **Ctrl + H** to open History
6. Are the 3 websites from Incognito showing in history? _______________
7. Why or why not? _______________

**Step D: Clear browsing data**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + Delete**
2. Select Time range: **Last hour**
3. Check: Browsing history, Cookies, Cached images
4. Click **Clear data**
5. Press **Ctrl + H** — is the history cleared for the last hour? _______________

**Important question for CCC exam:**
Does Incognito mode hide your activity from your ISP? ___ (Yes/No)
Answer: No — Incognito only hides history locally on your computer.

steps.title: Identify and Analyze URLs
steps.instructions:
Every website has a URL (Uniform Resource Locator) — its address on the internet. Let us learn to read URLs.

**Step A: Analyze this URL**

Open Chrome and visit: `https://www.irctc.co.in/nget/train-search`

Break it down:
```
https://www.irctc.co.in/nget/train-search
```
- Protocol: _______________ (http or https?)
- Subdomain: _______________ (www)
- Domain name: _______________ (irctc)
- TLD: _______________ (.co.in)
- Path: _______________ (/nget/train-search)
- Is it secure (HTTPS)? _______________

**Step B: Analyze more URLs**

Visit each URL and fill in the table:

| URL | Protocol | Domain | TLD | Secure? |
|-----|----------|--------|-----|--------|
| https://www.google.com | | | | |
| https://www.digilocker.gov.in | | | | |
| https://mail.google.com | | | | |
| https://student.nielit.gov.in | | | | |

**Step C: Understand TLDs**
Match each TLD with its meaning:
- .com = _______________
- .gov.in = _______________
- .co.in = _______________
- .ac.in = _______________
- .org = _______________

Answers: Commercial, Indian Government, Commercial India, Academic India, Organization

**Step D: Security check**
- Visit `http://example.com` (HTTP without S)
- Visit `https://www.google.com` (HTTPS with S)
- What visual difference do you see in the address bar between HTTP and HTTPS?
  _______________
- Which one should you use for banking or entering passwords?
  _______________

**Take a screenshot of your completed URL analysis table and submit with your lab report.**
